summary: ternary parameters: boolean input, required true_val, false_val, and none_val (2.8+) for a None input (otherwise treated as false).
questions: How do I return a different value when the input is None in ternary?

answer_card.title: ternary parameters
answer_card.answer_md:
- `_input` (bool, required)
- `true_val` (required): returned when True
- `false_val`: returned when False
- `none_val` (2.8+): returned when the input is `None`; if unset, `None` is treated as False
